items.title: Show HN: Zero dependency cross-language background job queue server
items.contentSnippet:
I'm Chris, and this is Zizq, a centralised job queue with a heap of awesome features I won't list off here.
https://github.com/zizq-labs/zizq
It gets through the queue fast under heavy throughput and requires no setup out of the box. items.title: Show HN: TerrainSR – fast, realistic heightmap upscaling model
items.contentSnippet:
This is a model that I made for a historical game. I wanted to have a 1:1 scale model of Europe, but my problem was that 100m data was too low-res while 10m LIDAR data was patchy, took hundreds of GBs to store and was full of manmade objects like mines, buildings and so on.
I trained this model on undeveloped landscape so that it can quickly add plausible erosion features, rocks, etc to the low-resolution height data and sort of reconstruct what the terrain would look like before any human inter

items.contentSnippet:

items.contentSnippet:
Hi HN!
I posted AgentOS here a few months ago. Back then, it was pretty amazing to see what these agents can do and I'm improved it a lot since then.
The biggest change is that it's built for my phone now. I start work at my desk, walk away, and check on it or answer an agent from my phone over Tailscale. Chat sessions run in their own process, so restarting the server doesn't kill a turn that's halfway done.

items.title: Show HN: Bees – Run agentic teams on your own computer (open source)
items.contentSnippet:
Author here. Bees is an agentic harness that runs on your own machine — macOS, Windows and Linux, MIT/Apache 2.0.
The problem we kept hitting in client work: every agent platform wanted to be the place your documents live. We wanted the opposite — the orchestrator reads your files in place, on your disk, and we never see them.

items.title: Show HN: Vibeconferencing, Bring Claude Code or Codex into Your Google Meet
items.contentSnippet:
A friend and I built this for our own calls and are sharing it as is. The itch: we kept copy-pasting Granola transcripts into Claude mid-call, and wondered what would happen if the agent just joined.
Two-minute demo: https://youtu.be/XhCSRiiL67A
